scope_notes: Frontend positive uses the maintained triha_frontend module with public request/response/consume ports; the negative uses the unregistered legacy frontend and must fail the registered redirect contract.
Issue-flow positive drives only the CPU instruction/data interfaces and observes internal issue/writeback signals for checking; the corrupted-load negative changes only returned memory data.
These tests cover module behavior and do not claim LSU/cache correctness, physical timing or board operation.
